notes.title: Dicey Bugs is OUT NOW!
notes.content: [h2]🐞🎲 [b]Dicey Bugs is OUT NOW![/b] 🎲🐞[/h2][p]The wait is over — [b]Dicey Bugs[/b] has officially launched! It’s time to roll, capture, and conquer your way by controlling the battle in this bug-collecting adventure.[/p][p][b]What’s waiting for you inside?[/b][/p][list][*][p]🪲 [b]Capture & collect[/b] hundreds of adorable bugs[/p][/*][*][p]🎲 [b]Customize every die[/b] to craft your perfect strategy[/p][/*][*][p]⚔️ [b]Experiment with hundreds of builds[/b] — no two runs are the same[/p][/*][*][p]🛠️ [b]Boost your power[/b] with equipment & consumables[/p][/*][*][p]🏆 [b]Complete challenges[/b] to earn stamps and flex your progress[/p][/*][*][p]📺 [b]Twitch integration[/b] for wild, chat-driven chaos[/p][/*][*][p]📊 [b]Track your best runs[/b] and show off your stats[/p][/*][*][p]🎮 [b]Steam Deck ready[/b] — play anywhere[/p][/*][*][p]♾️ [b]Endless replayability[/b] where you control the run from the very first roll[/p][/*][/list][p]🔥 Whether you’re here for the strategy, the chaos, or the cute-but-deadly critters, [b]Dicey Bugs[/b] is ready to take over your game nights.[/p][p]👉 [b]Play now on Steam[/b]: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3438640/Dicey_Bugs"]Dicey Bugs[/url][/p]

notes.title: Steam Deck Support!
notes.content:
[h3]STEAMDECK SUPPORT[/h3][p]Now you can capture all your favorite bugs and build your favorite team on the go![/p][p][/p][h3]Fixes & Updates[/h3][p][b]DEMO:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Adds a "Randomize Party" button to the Party Selection that chooses 3 random units from your collection.[/p][/*][*][p]Adds Spanish and Japanese languages.[/p][/*][*][p]Updates the names and/or icons for Ranged Attack, Support Attack, and Ambush actions for easier clarity and readability.[/p][/*][*][p]Allows unit positions to be swapped while in the shop.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes a bug where KO, Ally KO, and Revive abilities were not always triggering correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes a bug where Lure was not always being removed if the unit is KO'd.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes a bug where confusion previews were using STR rather than damage dealt.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes some achievements that were not triggering correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Updates supporters list.
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]FULL GAME:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Adds a new unit and variant.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes "Fastest Run Time" stat not showing the correct time.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]
